thread:
rachel: RFC follow-up: proposing a "rollback-hint" pattern rather than binary leases. Controller emits soft hints + an epoched seed. Router/runtime merge hint + local health to pick action. Quick sanity-check?

phil: Sounds interesting. How is a "hint" different from confidence? Is it less prescriptive?

rachel: Yeshint = advisory, with three parts: epoch, seed, hint_level (0|1|2 where 2 ~= strong ask to fallback). Router treats 2 almost like lease loss but still logs and uses deterministic tie-breaker.

mina: I like advisory semantics. Concrete rule: if hint_level==2 -> treat as controller_suggest_fallback but still run deterministic split using epoch+req_id to avoid nondeterminism during partitions. If hint_level==1 -> downweight controller in scoring.

kai: Practical API: controller PATCH /policies/:id -> {epoch, seed, pct, hint_level, ttl}. Keep payload tiny. Router caches until ttl. If ttl expires, epoch stays but hint_level implicitly -> 2 (strong fallback) to be safe? That feels aggressive.

phil: I'd prefer ttl-expiry -> enter "safe-deteministic" mode: controller_confidence=0 and deterministic split with seed. Avoid surprise fallbacks.

rachel: Agreed. Safe-deterministic mode it is. Also require that hint_level changes are monotonic per-epoch (can't flip from 2->0 inside epoch) to avoid flip-flop attacks.

mina: Telemetry: unified event line: `ts node epoch policy_v action score hint_level reasons sample_id`. Keep it compact, sample request ids at 0.5%. Send aggregates per minute.

kai: Edge: what if many routers disagree and some follow hint and some don't? Use epoch+seed hashing to keep split reproducible; audit events will show distribution. We can alert if per-region action distribution variance > 15% for 5m.

phil: Local heuristics: keep them simple so they are auditable: sliding 30s err_rate, p95 latency, and threadpool saturation. Map to health_score 0..100. Final_score = floor((90*hint_influence + 10*local_health)/100) where hint_influence maps hint_level->value (0->100,1->60,2->10). Tunable per-policy.

rachel: Nice. Also add a tiny debug endpoint on router: GET /debug/rollout/:id?sample=1 returns last 50 compact decisions (ops-only). Runtime returns numeric decision codes.

policy-bot: policy-manager: applied policy "rb-hint-2026-04" epoch=7 to region us-west-1 at 2026-04-02T11:02:00Z

mina: Hedging: opt-in. Router can issue one parallel hedge to fallback if hint_level>=1 and hedging enabled. Hedge budget 30ms. If hedge finishes sooner, choose that response but still emit hedged_event. Limit hedges per-node to 5 RPS.

kai: Oscillation guard: min_stable_window and cool_down fields required in policy. Default min_stable_window=90s, cool_down=300s. Also require two consecutive good windows to re-enable.

phil: Security: no user content in events, only request_hash. Retention per-org.

rachel: Action items: (1) mina: write compact audit line + aggregates; (2) phil: stub router debug API + deterministic hashing snippet; (3) kai: implement hint->influence mapping in sim harness and run weight sweep. I'll fold into RFC appendix and ping arch. /cc @mina @phil @kai
